summary.zhCn: Billy Markus 与 Jackson Palmer 于2013年推出的开源 Scrypt 工作量证明网络，以固定每区块1万 DOGE 的尾部发行和与 Litecoin 合并挖矿著称。
summary.en: An open-source Scrypt proof-of-work network launched by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer in 2013, known for a permanent 10,000-DOGE block subsidy and merged mining with Litecoin.
